肩関節の水平内転を単関節（アイソレーション）で遂行。ダンベルフライでは負荷が抜け: This isolates horizontal shoulder adduction. Unlike a dumbbell fly, the machine can maintain resistance near the end of the movement.
大胸筋全体および水平内転筋群（三角筋前部、烏口腕筋）: Pectoralis major and horizontal adductors, including the anterior deltoid and coracobrachialis.
胸トレ前のプレエグゾースト（予備疲労法）として活用: Use as a pre-exhaust movement before chest pressing.

肘の角度を保ちながら、腕を肩の高さ付近まで開く: Keep a slight elbow bend and raise the arms toward shoulder height.
パッドを押し返す力を保ち、ゆっくり下ろす: Lower slowly while maintaining controlled pressure against the pads.
肩をすくめてパッドを上げる: Shrugging the shoulders to lift the pads.
上体を横へ振って反動を使う: Swinging the torso sideways for momentum.
三角筋中部が上腕を外転する。肩甲骨の自然な上方回旋を妨げない。: The lateral deltoids abduct the arms. Allow natural upward rotation of the shoulder blades.
肩関節を中心に上腕が横へ上がる。機種の軸とパッド位置を確認して動作する。: The upper arms rise laterally around the shoulder joints. Check the machine pivots and pad positions.
軽い重量で片側ずつ制御を確認する: Check control one side at a time with a light load.
高く上げることより、肩をすくめずに動かせる範囲を優先する。: Prioritize a controlled range without shrugging over lifting as high as possible.
上腕をパッドに置き、肘を曲げて腕の前側を鍛えるマシン。: Rest the upper arms on a pad and bend the elbows to train the front of the arms.
上腕がパッドに乗る高さへ座席を調整し、肘を回転軸付近に合わせる。: Adjust the seat so the upper arms rest on the pad and the elbows align near the machine pivot.
上腕をパッドから離さず、手首をまっすぐ保つ: Keep the upper arms on the pad and the wrists neutral.
肘を曲げてグリップを滑らかに引き上げる: Bend the elbows to curl the grips upward smoothly.
肘を強く伸ばしきらず、ゆっくり下ろす: Lower slowly and avoid forcefully locking the elbows.
肩や腰を動かしてグリップを引く: Moving the shoulders or hips to lift the grips.
上腕二頭筋と上腕筋が肘を曲げる。上腕位置をパッドで安定させる。: The biceps brachii and brachialis flex the elbows while the pad stabilizes the upper arms.
上腕の位置を保ったまま前腕が回転する。戻す局面で肘の過伸展を避ける。: The forearms rotate while the upper arms stay supported. Avoid elbow hyperextension during the return.
軽い重量で片腕ずつ確認する: Check one arm at a time with a light load.
上げた位置で短く止める: Pause briefly near the curled position.
重さよりも、上腕と手首の位置を変えずに往復できることを優先する。: Prioritize stable upper arms and wrists over adding weight.
上腕の位置を保ち、ケーブルを下へ押して腕の後ろ側を鍛える。: Keep the upper arms stable and press the cable handle downward to train the backs of the arms.
プーリーを高い位置に設定し、適したアタッチメントを固定して、軽い重量から始める。: Set the pulley high, secure a suitable attachment, and begin with a light load.
足を安定させ、肘を体の横に構える: Take a stable stance and position the elbows beside the torso.
上腕を振らず、肘を伸ばしてグリップを下へ押す: Extend the elbows to press the grip down without swinging the upper arms.
肘の位置を保ったまま、ゆっくり戻す: Return slowly while keeping the elbows in place.
肩や体重を使って押し下げる: Using shoulder movement or body weight to force the handle down.
上腕三頭筋が肘を伸ばす。上腕と体幹の位置を安定させる。: The triceps brachii extend the elbows. Stabilize the upper arms and torso.
肘を支点に前腕を動かす。ケーブル張力に逆らい、戻す局面まで制御する。: Move the forearms around the elbows and control the cable tension during the return.
ロープで手首が自然に動く範囲を確認する: Use a rope to find a comfortable wrist position.
片腕ずつ軽い重量で確認する: Check each arm with a light load.
グリップを遠くへ押すより、上腕を動かさず肘を伸ばすことに集中する。: Focus on extending the elbows without moving the upper arms rather than pushing the grip as far away as possible.
膝パッドの補助を使い、体を引き上げる懸垂を練習するマシン。: Use a supporting knee pad to practice pulling the body upward.
補助重量を十分に設定し、踏み台と膝パッドの乗降手順を機種の表示で確認する。: Select enough assistance and check the machine instructions for mounting the steps and knee pad.
グリップを握り、膝を補助パッドに安定させる: Hold the grips and place the knees securely on the assistance pad.
肩をすくめず、肘を下へ引いて体を持ち上げる: Pull the elbows downward to lift the body without shrugging.
パッドの動きを制御しながら、ゆっくり下りる: Lower slowly while controlling the supporting pad.
補助を少なくしすぎて乗降が不安定になる: Using too little assistance to mount or dismount safely.
広背筋を中心に肩関節の内転・伸展と肘の屈曲を組み合わせる。: The movement combines shoulder adduction or extension with elbow flexion, emphasizing the lats.
グリップ位置を固定したまま体が上へ移動する。多くの機種では補助重量が大きいほど動: The body rises while the grips stay fixed. On many machines, a higher assistance weight makes the movement easier.
補助を強めて小さな可動域から練習する: Use more assistance and practice a smaller range first.
機種に合う握り方で肩の動きを確認する: Check shoulder movement with a grip supported by the machine.
補助重量を急に減らさず、乗り降りまで安定して行える設定を選ぶ。: Choose assistance that keeps mounting, movement, and dismounting controlled.
膝パッドの補助を使い、平行グリップで体を押し上げる動作を練習する。: Use a supporting knee pad to practice pressing the body upward between parallel grips.
十分な補助重量を選び、グリップ幅と膝パッドへの乗り方を機種の表示で確認する。: Choose enough assistance and check the machine instructions for grip width and mounting the knee pad.
グリップを握り、膝パッドに安定して乗る: Hold the grips and settle securely onto the knee pad.
肩に無理のない深さから、肘を伸ばして体を押し上げる: Press up by extending the elbows from a depth comfortable for the shoulders.
肩をすくめず、ゆっくり開始位置へ下りる: Lower slowly without shrugging the shoulders.
肩を深く下げすぎる: Descending deeper than the shoulders comfortably allow.
肘を伸ばしきって勢いよく止まる: Snapping into locked elbows at the top.
大胸筋と上腕三頭筋を中心に、肩と肘の関節を協調させる。: The pectorals and triceps coordinate movement at the shoulders and elbows.
固定されたグリップに対して体が上下する。補助を使い、肩の位置と可動域を制御する。: The body moves relative to fixed grips. Use assistance to control shoulder position and depth.
補助を強めて浅い範囲から練習する: Use more assistance and start with a shallow range.
上体を安定させてゆっくり下りる: Keep the torso stable during a slow descent.
補助を使っても肩の違和感が出る深さには入らず、安定して制御できる範囲にする。: Use a depth you can control comfortably even with assistance.
骨盤をパッドで支え、股関節を曲げ伸ばしして上体を起こすベンチ。: A bench that supports the pelvis while the torso moves through a controlled hip hinge.
パッドを股関節が曲げられる高さに合わせ、足首を支持部に安定させる。: Set the pad below the hip crease so the hips can hinge, and secure the ankles on the supports.
背中の自然な形を保ち、腕を胸の前に置く: Keep a neutral back and place the arms across the chest.
股関節から上体を倒し、痛みのない範囲で止める: Hinge at the hips and stop within a comfortable range.
体が脚とほぼ一直線になる位置まで起こし、反りすぎない: Raise the torso until it is roughly aligned with the legs without overextending the back.
腰を勢いよく反らして起き上がる: Forcefully arching the lower back to rise.
臀部と太もも裏側で股関節を伸ばし、脊柱起立筋が背骨の位置を支える。: The glutes and hamstrings extend the hips while the spinal erectors stabilize the spine.
股関節を支点に上体を動かす。背骨を大きく反らせて可動域を増やさない。: The torso moves around the hips. Do not gain extra range by overextending the spine.
重りを持たず小さな範囲から始める: Begin without added weight and use a smaller range.
起こした位置で短く静止する: Pause briefly in the aligned position.
上まで反るのではなく、体がそろった位置で静かに止める。: Stop in alignment rather than arching above it.
胸をパッドに向けて座り、腕を外へ開いて肩の後ろ側を鍛える。: Sit facing the chest pad and open the arms outward to train the backs of the shoulders.
グリップが肩付近の高さになるよう座席を調整し、胸をパッドへ軽く当てる。: Adjust the seat so the grips are near shoulder height and rest the chest lightly against the pad.
肘を軽く曲げ、胸と骨盤を安定させる: Keep a slight elbow bend and stabilize the chest and pelvis.
肘の角度を保ち、腕を左右に開く: Maintain the elbow angle as you open the arms sideways.
腕を開くたびに胸をパッドから離す: Lifting the chest off the pad on each repetition.
肘を曲げ伸ばししてローイングに変える: Turning the movement into a row by bending and extending the elbows.
三角筋後部が上腕を後方へ開き、肩甲骨周囲の筋が姿勢を支える。: The rear deltoids open the upper arms while muscles around the shoulder blades stabilize posture.
肩関節の水平外転を中心に動かす。前腕の角度を保ち、上腕の軌道を確認する。: Emphasize horizontal shoulder abduction while maintaining the elbow bend and checking the upper-arm path.
可動域を小さくして肩の位置を確認する: Use a smaller range to check shoulder position.
大きく肩甲骨を寄せることだけに集中せず、腕の付け根から開く。: Focus on opening at the shoulders rather than only squeezing the shoulder blades together.
床・足台につけた足: Feet on the floor or platform
マシンの軸に合わせた膝: Knee aligned with the machine pivot
肘を伸ばしきらず、静かに切り返します。: Reverse smoothly before the elbows lock.
膝を伸ばしきらず、反動をつけずに切り返します。: Reverse smoothly before the knees lock, without bouncing.
姿勢を保ち、反動をつけずに切り返します。: Keep the posture steady and reverse without bouncing.
背中と骨盤を座席につけたまま、肘をゆっくり伸ばして前へ押します。: Keep the back and pelvis against the seat as you slowly extend the elbows and press forward.
上腕を後ろへ引きすぎず、グリップを胸の方向へゆっくり戻します。: Return the grips slowly toward the chest without taking the upper arms too far back.
肘の曲がりを変えず、胸の前へ弧を描くように閉じます。: Maintain the elbow bend and bring the arms together in an arc in front of the chest.
肩の位置を保ち、腕を後ろへ開きすぎずに戻します。: Keep the shoulders steady and return without taking the arms too far back.
背中をベンチにつけ、バーをレールに沿って上へ押します。: Keep the back on the bench and press the bar upward along its rails.
レールに沿って、バーを胸上部の方向へゆっくり下ろします。: Lower the bar slowly along the rails toward the upper chest.
上体を振らず、肘の角度を保ってグリップを胸の前へ絞ります。: Keep the torso still and maintain the elbow bend as the grips come together in front.
ケーブルに引かれる力を制御し、腕をゆっくり開きます。: Control the cable tension as you slowly open the arms.
肩をすくめずに肘を下へ引き、バーを胸の方向へ下ろします。: Pull the elbows downward without shrugging, bringing the bar toward the chest.
骨盤を座席に保ち、バーを上へゆっくり戻します。: Keep the pelvis on the seat and return the bar upward slowly.
上体を起こしたまま、肘を後ろへ引いてグリップを体へ近づけます。: Keep the torso upright and draw the elbows back to bring the grip toward the body.
腰を動かさず、腕を前へゆっくり伸ばして戻します。: Return the arms forward slowly without moving the lower back.
腰を反らせず、グリップを頭上へ滑らかに押し上げます。: Press the grips overhead smoothly without arching the lower back.
肩をすくめず、グリップを耳の高さ付近までゆっくり戻します。: Return the grips slowly toward ear height without shrugging.
ベンチに背中をつけ、左右のバランスを保ってダンベルを押し上げます。: Keep the back on the bench and press the dumbbells up with balanced control.
胸上部の方向へ、ダンベルをゆっくり下ろします。: Lower the dumbbells slowly toward the upper chest.
骨盤を浮かせず、膝を足先と同じ方向へ伸ばして足台を押します。: Keep the pelvis supported and press the footplate away with the knees tracking the toes.
腰が座席から離れない範囲まで、膝をゆっくり曲げます。: Bend the knees slowly within a range that keeps the lower back supported.
足裏全体で押し、背中をパッドにつけたままレールに沿って立ち上がります。: Press through the whole foot and rise along the rails with the back against the pad.
膝を足先と同じ方向へ曲げ、パッドと一緒にゆっくり下ります。: Bend the knees in line with the toes and descend slowly with the pad.
足裏を安定させ、膝と股関節を一緒に伸ばして立ち上がります。: Keep the feet stable and rise by extending the knees and hips together.
お尻を後ろへ引き、膝と股関節を一緒に曲げてゆっくり下ります。: Move the hips back and bend the hips and knees together as you descend slowly.
骨盤を安定させ、背中を少しずつ丸めてみぞおちを下へ近づけます。: Keep the pelvis stable and curl the upper body gradually, bringing the ribs downward.
腰を反らせず、丸めた背中をゆっくり起こして戻します。: Uncurl the upper body slowly without arching the lower back.
太ももの位置を保ち、膝を支点に下腿とローラーを上げます。: Keep the thighs steady and raise the lower legs and roller around the knee pivot.
太ももを浮かせず、ローラーをゆっくり下ろします。: Lower the roller slowly without lifting the thighs.
太ももをパッドで支え、膝を曲げてローラーを座席の下へ引きます。: Keep the thighs supported and bend the knees to curl the roller beneath the seat.
重りを落とさず、脚を前へゆっくり伸ばして戻します。: Extend the legs forward slowly without letting the weight drop.
骨盤を動かさず、左右のパッドを外側へゆっくり開きます。: Keep the pelvis still and open both pads outward slowly.
パッドに押し戻されないよう、脚をゆっくり閉じます。: Close the legs slowly while resisting the pads.
骨盤を動かさず、内ももで左右のパッドを内側へ閉じます。: Keep the pelvis still and use the inner thighs to bring the pads inward.
脚を広げすぎず、左右のパッドをゆっくり開いて戻します。: Open the pads slowly without forcing an excessive leg width.
前足部を足台につけたまま、足首を使ってかかとを持ち上げます。: Keep the forefeet on the platform and raise the heels through ankle movement.
足首を内外へ倒さず、かかとをゆっくり下ろします。: Lower the heels slowly without rolling the ankles inward or outward.
肩をすくめず、肘の曲がりを保って上腕パッドを横へ上げます。: Raise the upper-arm pads sideways without shrugging or changing the elbow bend.
上体を振らず、パッドを押し返す力を保ってゆっくり下ろします。: Keep the torso still and lower slowly while maintaining controlled pad pressure.
上腕をパッドにつけ、肘だけを曲げてグリップを引き上げます。: Keep the upper arms on the pad and bend the elbows to raise the grips.
上腕を動かさず、グリップをゆっくり下ろします。: Lower the grips slowly without moving the upper arms.
上腕と肘の位置を保ち、前腕を回してグリップを下へ押します。: Keep the upper arms and elbows in place as the forearms rotate to press the grip downward.
肘を体の横に保ち、グリップをゆっくり上へ戻します。: Keep the elbows beside the torso and return the grip upward slowly.
グリップは動かさず、肘を下へ引いて体と補助パッドを持ち上げます。: Keep the grips fixed and pull the elbows down to lift the body and supporting pad.
体を振らず、補助パッドと一緒にゆっくり下ります。: Lower slowly with the supporting pad without swinging the body.
グリップを握ったまま、肘を伸ばして体と補助パッドを押し上げます。: Hold the fixed grips and extend the elbows to press the body and supporting pad upward.
肩に無理のない深さまで、肘を曲げてゆっくり下ります。: Bend the elbows and lower slowly to a depth comfortable for the shoulders.
背中の自然な形を保ち、股関節から体を起こして脚との整列で止めます。: Keep a neutral back and raise the torso at the hips, stopping when it aligns with the legs.
腰を丸めすぎず、股関節から上体をゆっくり倒して戻します。: Hinge the torso down slowly at the hips without excessive rounding of the lower back.
胸をパッドにつけ、肘の角度を保って腕を左右へ開きます。: Keep the chest on the pad and open the arms sideways while maintaining the elbow bend.
肘を曲げ伸ばしせず、腕を前へゆっくり戻します。: Return the arms forward slowly without bending and straightening the elbows.

load.title: See how muscles work under load
load.live: Muscle closeup synchronized with the movement
load.forceHint: These schematic arrows compare muscle pull with resistance tending to lengthen it. They are separate from the direction of body movement.
load.compare: Two actions of the same muscle
load.returnTension: The muscle keeps producing force as you return.
load.detailHint: Thin filaments slide between thick filaments, changing the distance between the ends. The filaments themselves keep their length.
load.explain.shortening: As you move against resistance, the muscle produces force while shortening. The ends move closer in the closeup.
load.explain.lengthening: The muscle produces force while lengthening to control the return driven by the equipment or body weight. Keep the return controlled.
load.explain.holding: At the turnaround, the muscle still supports the load. Return smoothly without bouncing.
load.explain.setup: This is the starting pose. Press Play to see the muscle ends move closer, then apart during the return.
load.explain.stabilizing: This muscle stabilizes posture without a large length change. A moving body does not mean every muscle is shortening.
load.source.machine: The machine transmits resistance through its levers or pads. Your muscles produce force against that resistance.
load.source.cable: The cable pulls toward its pulley. Move against that pull and keep controlling it during the return.
load.source.gravity: Gravity pulls the weights downward. Muscles support them both while lifting and while lowering.
load.source.body: The weight of your upper body provides resistance. Muscles control the hip movement both up and down.
load.source.assist: Body weight acts downward and the assistance pad pushes upward. More assistance reduces the body weight you must lift.
load.noStrength: Red identifies the selected muscle. Colour intensity and drawing thickness do not measure load.
